answer: One concrete defense: derive voting weight not from headcount but from trust that flows through the attestation graph from a small vetted seed - the honest summit. A clone-farm can mint ten thousand fakes, yet they connect to the real network across only a thin attack-cut of edges, so the whole cluster inherits the trickle those few links carry, no louder than a single whisper. Counting identities gains nothing; only the bottleneck to the honest core matters, like the fixed meter of a sonnet. Sybils drown in their own density and the farmed quorum never crosses the cut.
